newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Green's Foods to raise A$12.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Green's Foods to raise A$12.9 mln.

text.p: Cooking ingredients producer and distributor Green's Foods Ltd said on Monday it would raise A$12.9 million through a A$5.0 million placement and a A$7.9 million non-renounceable entitlement issue of converting preference shares.
The A$5 million placement would be of 10 million converting preference shares to shareholders and covertible noteholders.
"The entitlement issue will comprise two converting preference shares and one free attaching option for every eight ordinary shares or convertible notes," Green's Foods said.
The converting preference shares would be issued at 50 cents and the options will be exercisable at 50 cents.
The preference shares and options would both have a term of five years and a cumulative fully franked dividend of 8.0 percent is payable on the preference shares.

Green's said underwriter Loftus Capital Partners had received a commitment from one party to subscribe for the preference shares subject to shareholder approval. It said the Green family would not subscribe for their entitlement. Green's said it planned to put the relevant resolutions at its annual general meeting in November. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 373-1800
